1985-12-27: Behind Olden Polynice's 19 points, Virginia Cavaliers pulled away from Long Island University 71–52. Andre Ervin had 16 for Long Island University.
2000-11-17: Virginia Cavaliers blew out Long Island University 96–50 as Stephane Dondon scored a team-high 17. Dawan Gary had 12 for Long Island University.
